name: jev-codex-token-saver
description: Use bounded Jev evidence selection to keep broad local search results out of Codex context.

interface.shortDescription: Return focused evidence from broad local searches
interface.longDescription: A local MCP evidence gateway that searches workspaces and large text files inside bounded tool calls, sends only candidate excerpts to Jev for typed relevance scoring, and returns selected exact evidence to Codex. One targeted Jev recovery pass can resolve a missing fact; small results bypass Jev and failures use a visible local fallback.
defaultPrompt: Investigate this codebase with bounded Jev evidence selection.
